rationale: The Lean target exactly formalizes the MGF factorization in Equation (2.6) on the source's independent symmetric Bernoulli instances. Its sum, product, exponential, expectation, coefficients, and independence premise all have the intended meanings. The formal statement is strictly more general because it applies to arbitrary finite independent real-valued families with finite individual exponential moments, arbitrary probability measures, and all real lambda. Hence Lean implies the selected source result, while that restricted source result does not by itself imply the full Lean proposition.
